children: Gary M. Lauder disclosed a 17.0% stake in SoundThinking, Inc. and switched from a passive Schedule 13G to an active Schedule 13D. He filed the new disclosure on Oct. 02, 2026, alongside a deal for SoundThinking to be acquired by Transom Capital affiliates. The move highlights his agreement to support the tender offer and roll over proceeds into the buyer’s new parent entity.

Lauder signed a Tender, Support and Reinvestment Agreement tied to Transom’s $8.00-per-share tender offer plus a contingent value right of up to $3.00. He agreed to "tender their aggregate 2,255,406 shares," not withdraw them, waive appraisal rights, and vote against any competing proposals while the deal moves forward and the stock prepares to be delisted after the merger.

He also plans to reinvest cash from the tender into the new holding structure, targeting "collectively holding approximately 17.5% of the equity of Topco" on a fully diluted basis. Transom will pick all directors of the new Topco board, while Lauder will receive a nonvoting board observer right, subject to ongoing ownership.

Gary M. Lauder is Managing Director of Lauder Partners, a venture capital firm, and he manages related family investment entities. He serves as manager of Lauder Partners and trustee of The Gary M. Lauder Revocable Trust, while Roaring Fork Trust Company, Inc. serves as trustee of the Gary M. Lauder 2015 Trust. Lauder Partners focuses on technology and growth companies, investing across early-stage ventures and select public tech names.

title: Gary M. Lauder Backs Buyout, Commits Rollover at SoundThinking with 17.0% Stake
